description: Advanced Monolithic Systems AMS1117-3.3 — 3.3 V fixed LDO regulator, 1 A max, SOT-223 package. Ubiquitous, cheap, and good enough for most digital rails. Use when you want to drop 5 V → 3.3 V without a switcher.
name: ams1117-3v3
watch_out_for: Dropout ~1.1-1.3 V at 1 A — needs Vin ≥ 4.4 V for 3.3 V out at full load. Inefficient (linear): power dissipated as heat is (Vin - 3.3) × Iout. 22 µF output cap minimum for stability. For battery-powered low-Iq projects use AP2112K instead (much lower quiescent).
